title: Argentinian Yautia Gratin
description: A rich and creamy gratin featuring yautia, a staple root vegetable from Argentina. Velvety and comforting, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange the sliced yautia in a single layer.
In a medium saucepan, combine the grated gratin cheese, heavy velvety cream, minced quick garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat, stirring until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Pour the cheese sauce over the yautia, making sure they are fully coated.
Transfer the baking dish to the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the yautia is tender.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
